name: [🌋] Survive Volcano for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Escape Volcano for Brainrots! 🌋

Run fast and collect Brainrots! 🏃
Dodge the lava waves when they strike! 🌋
Survive longer to collect even MORE Brainrots! ⚡

Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more cash 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock extra slots and place more Brainrots 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash even while you’re offline 💤

👍 Like the game and join the group to unlock FREE EPIC BRAINROTS!
